certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: The ISO27001 certification for Whereby was secured in February 2022 and the re-certification was obtained in 2025, which can be downloaded here.

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: The data centres are, amongst others, SOC2 audited, ISO27001 certified and are held to the highest standards of security and uptime.

certifications.name: HIPAA BAA
certifications.proof_quote: Whereby has prepared and will sign a standard Business Associate Agreement that is adequate for all of our HIPAA-compliant customers, at no extra charge.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Our business model is to provide a paid service to users who need additional features on top of the Free version, and does not rely on widespread collection of general user data.

certifications.name: PCI DSS SAQ-A
certifications.proof_quote: We are PCI DSS SAQ-A compliant, and we are performing external vulnerability scans every quarter with an external approved scanning vendor (ASV).

privacy.ai_training_note: Whereby explicitly states it does not process media for its own purposes: 'We only process media to enable participants to use our Service; we do not process media for our own purposes.' No AI/ML training policy is separately disclosed, but video and audio are not stored beyond transit. Privacy policy last updated July 4, 2022 and may not address newer AI features.
privacy.data_region: EU (AWS Dublin, Ireland). Account data stored in Ireland. Usage data may also reside in Ireland and the US per the privacy policy. No customer-selectable residency options documented.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS 1.2 with restricted cipher suite. DTLS-SRTP for all media streams.

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AES-256; disk encryption enabled on servers; backup data stored encrypted offsite.

security.name: End-to-End Encryption
security.value: Available for small rooms (peer-to-peer, DTLS-SRTP with client-generated keys). Large rooms: encrypted media decrypted only in server memory, not persisted.

security.name: Media Storage
security.value: Whereby does not store video or audio data. Transient only during transmission. No cloud storage of meeting content by default.

security.name: Penetration Testing
security.value: Regular third-party pen tests using OWASP methodology. Executive summary available under NDA on request.

security.name: Vulnerability Disclosure
security.value: Self-hosted VDP (not HackerOne or Bugcrowd). Contact: security@whereby.com. PGP key available. Hall of Fame for valid reporters at whereby.com/information/security/vdp/hof/.

security.name: Bug Bounty
security.value: No formal paid bug bounty program on HackerOne or Bugcrowd. VDP states researchers 'will be added to our private Bug Bounty Program in the future' depending on criticality and budget.

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Hosted on AWS Dublin, Ireland (EU data residency). AWS itself holds SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications for its data centers.

security.name: PCI DSS
security.value: SAQ-A compliant for payment handling. Quarterly external vulnerability scans via approved scanning vendor (ASV). Payment processing via Stripe.

products.name: Whereby Meetings
products.data_scope: No audio or video stored. Chat data local-browser only for meeting duration. Local recording only (saved to user device). Account info in Ireland. HIPAA compliance requires BAA; not enabled by default on free plan.
products.notes: Free plan available. Pro ($10.99/mo), Business ($13.99/host/mo), Enterprise (custom). HIPAA compliance with BAA available at no extra cost on annual plans.

products.name: Whereby Embedded
products.data_scope: API-driven programmatic room creation. Cloud recording supported only with customer-owned S3 bucket for HIPAA compliance. Chat local only. DPA included for Business and Enterprise customers.
products.notes: Programmable rooms, custom branding, SDK tooling. HIPAA-compliant with BAA on Enterprise plan. Build plan offers HIPAA as paid add-on. Usage-based API pricing.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium and SaaS subscription tiers. Meetings: Free, Pro ($10.99/mo), Business ($13.99/host/mo), Enterprise (custom). Embedded: usage-based API pricing.
compare.data_residency: EU only (AWS Dublin, Ireland). No multi-region or customer-selectable residency options documented.

flags: SOC 2 is NOT held by Whereby itself. Only its data center provider (AWS) is SOC2 audited. Homepage and security page language about SOC2 refers solely to infrastructure, not Whereby's own operations.
No formal bug bounty platform (HackerOne or Bugcrowd). Self-hosted VDP only, with a possible future private bug bounty hinted at in the policy.

HIPAA compliance is operationally available via BAA, not a formal third-party certification. Customer must configure rooms correctly (locked rooms, UUID names, own S3 for recordings) for full HIPAA posture.
Privacy policy last updated July 4, 2022. May not reflect newer AI features (transcriptions, captions) added since then. No AI training terms found.
No explicit AI training policy page, but media is explicitly not stored or processed for Whereby's own purposes. Low risk but warrants monitoring as product adds AI-powered features.
